scripts.features:
1. Visual Enhancements (ESP)
Allows you to see other players through walls and obstacles. You can display their names, health bars, equipped tools, and draw boxes or skeletons around them. It also features off-screen indicators that draw arrows on the edge of your screen pointing toward hidden enemies.
2. Combat Assistance
Aimbot: Automatically adjusts your camera to lock onto enemies. It includes options for smooth movement, target prediction for moving players, and a visual field-of-view circle.
Triggerbot: Automatically simulates a mouse click to shoot the exact moment your crosshair hovers over a valid target.
3. Player Modifications
Grants your character superhuman physical abilities. You can increase your walking speed, jump much higher, fly freely, walk through solid objects (Noclip), gain infinite health (God Mode), or expand the invisible hitboxes of enemies to make them easier to hit.
4. World and Environment
Lets you alter the game's visual settings. You can remove all darkness and shadows (Fullbright), remove or customize fog, change the time of day, and activate an "FPS Boost" that simplifies graphics to improve performance on slower devices.
5. Cosmetics and Utilities
Includes a fully customizable crosshair, a spinning neon "China Hat" accessory for your character, an Anti-AFK feature to prevent the game from kicking you for being idle, and a small watermark displaying your real-time FPS and ping.
6. Interface and Protection
All features are controlled via a modern, draggable menu. You can save and load custom configuration profiles, assign keyboard shortcuts for quick access, and use a player list to whitelist or blacklist specific users. Additionally, it features an Anti-Kick system designed to block the game from removing you from the server.

scripts.features:
Stand cmds

-- how to multi-target?
-- example: .k user1 user2
--          .lk user1 user2
--          .watchlk user1 user2

.s -- summon the stand
.v -- hide / void the stand

.left -- stand position left
.right -- stand position right
.change char -- saitama, bald, genos, garou, hunter, batter, blade, esper, ninja, purple, tech, zombie

.k @user -- kill once (single or multiple)
.lk @user -- loop kill (single or multiple)
.kstando @user -- detects a stand user and uses a different attack method
.lkstando @user -- same but loopkill
.watchlk @user -- loop kill + track leave/rejoin
.watchlk off

.kb @user -- stay behind target, then send 1-4
.kb off

.f @user -- fling target
.bring @user -- hunter skill 
.b @user -- same as .bring
.throw @user -- throw trash can (owner can use .throw me)
.void @user -- hunter void (skill 1 or 2)
.hv @user -- same as .void
.ult -- activate ult

.op -- owner protect toggle
.sp -- stand protect toggle
.m1block -- M1 when owner blocks
.exploiter -- unpredictable vs other exploits
.exploiter off
.formation -- sync stands
.inv -- invisible mode
.inv off
.toxic -- taunt after kills
.toxic off

.enable -- chat 1-4: stand comes in front and uses skill
.disable
1 -- use skill 1 (after .enable or during .kb)
2 -- use skill 2
3 -- use skill 3
4 -- use skill 4 (hunter skips 4)

.tp me place
.tp @user place

places:
safe, mountain1, mountain2, jail, death, middle, corner

.br @user -- bring target to you

.owner @user -- temporary owner
.backup -- restore original owner
.rejoin -- rejoin server
.cmds -- show commands

.unfreeze -- unfreeze stand

-- Premium
.freeze -- freeze stand
.betray @user -- steal stand
.kick @user -- kick other free stands
.ban @user -- ban other free stands
(You can use it on specific free users or on all free users in the server)

scripts.title: Troll gui (FE)
scripts.script:
--[[ WARNING: Настроено специально для мобильного эксикьютора Delta ]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)

if not PlayerGui then return end

-- Удаляем старую копию скрипта перед перезапусками
if PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("TrollGuiContainer") then
    PlayerGui.TrollGuiContainer:Destroy()
end

-- Создание интерфейса (контейнер)
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "TrollGuiContainer"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = PlayerGui

-- Главное окно
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(179, 0, 0)
Frame.BorderSizePixel = 5
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0.35, 0)
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 260)

local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TextLabel.Parent = Frame
TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TextLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.05, 0)
TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30)
TextLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
TextLabel.Text = "troll gui"
TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
TextLabel.TextSize = 33

local TextLabel_2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
TextLabel_2.Parent = Frame
TextLabel_2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TextLabel_2.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.18, 0)
TextLabel_2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30)
TextLabel_2.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
TextLabel_2.Text = "delta stable"
TextLabel_2.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
TextLabel_2.TextSize = 18

-- Функция перетаскивания (оптимизирована под сенсорный ввод Delta)
local function dragify(Main)
	local dragToggle, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
	Main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = Main.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragToggle = false end
			end)
		end
	end)
	Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragToggle then
			local Delta = input.Position - dragStart
			local Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + Delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + Delta.Y)
			TweenService:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Position = Position}):Play()
		end
	end)
end
dragify(Frame)

-- Конструктор кнопок
local function createButton(name, text, pos, size)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = name
	btn.Parent = Frame
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 34)
	btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 3, 2)
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 3
	btn.Position = pos
	btn.Size = size
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
	btn.Text = text
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	btn.TextScaled = true
	return btn
end

local decalspam = createButton("decalspam", "decal spam", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.35, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 25))
local skybox = createButton("skybox", "skybox", UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 0.35, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 25))
local hint = createButton("hint", "hint", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.48, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 25))
local jumpscare1 = createButton("jumpscare1", "jumpscare 1", UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 0.48, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 25))
local disco = createButton("disco", "disco", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.61, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 25))
local jumpscare2 = createButton("jumpscare2", "jumpscare 2", UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 0.61, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 25))
local music2 = createButton("music2", "theme", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.74, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 22))
local musicstop = createButton("musicstop", "stop music", UDim2.new(0.53, 0, 0.74, 0), UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 22))
local particlesspam = createButton("particlesspam", "particles spam", UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.86, 0), UDim2.new(0, 195, 0, 25))

-- ==================== ФУНКЦИОНАЛ КНОПОК ====================

-- 1. СПАМ ДЕКАЛЯМИ НА БЛОКИ
decalspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local function applyDecals(root)
		for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("BasePart") then
				v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
				v.Transparency = 0
				local faces = {Enum.NormalId.Front, Enum.NormalId.Back, Enum.NormalId.Right, Enum.NormalId.Left, Enum.NormalId.Top, Enum.NormalId.Bottom}
				for _, face in pairs(faces) do
					local d = Instance.new("Decal")
					d.Texture = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
					d.Face = face
					d.Parent = v
				end
			end
			applyDecals(v)
		end
	end
	applyDecals(Workspace)
end)

-- 2. ИЗМЕНЕНИЕ НЕБА (SKYBOX)
skybox.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local s = Instance.new("Sky")
	s.Name = "TrollSky"
	s.SkyboxBk = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	s.SkyboxDn = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	s.SkyboxFt = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	s.SkyboxLf = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	s.SkyboxRt = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	s.SkyboxUp = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	s.Parent = Lighting
	Lighting.TimeOfDay = "12:00:00"
end)

-- 3. ВСПЛЫВАЮЩАЯ ПОДСКАЗКА (HINT)
hint.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local m = Instance.new("Hint")
	m.Text = "team tubers93 join today!"
	m.Parent = Workspace
	task.wait(5)
	m:Destroy()
end)

-- 4. РАДУЖНАЯ ДИСКОТЕКА
local discoActive = false
disco.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if discoActive then return end
	discoActive = true
	local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect", Lighting)
	local counter = 0
	task.spawn(function()
		while discoActive do
			local color = Color3.fromHSV(math.acos(math.cos(counter * math.pi)) / math.pi, 1, 1)
			cc.TintColor = color
			Lighting.Ambient = color
			counter = counter + 0.01
			task.wait(0.05)
		end
	end)
end)

-- 5. ГРОМКАЯ МУЗЫКА (1839247124, Громкость 99999)
local currentSound
music2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if currentSound then currentSound:Destroy() end
	currentSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	currentSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1839247124"
	currentSound.Volume = 99999
	currentSound.Looped = true
	currentSound.Parent = Workspace
	currentSound:Play()
end)

-- СТОП МУЗЫКА И ДИСКО
musicstop.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	if currentSound then currentSound:Stop() currentSound:Destroy() end
	discoActive = false
	for _, v in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then v:Destroy() end
	end
end)

-- 6. СПАМ ЛЕТАЮЩИМИ ЧАСТИЦАМИ НА ГОЛОВЫ
particlesspam.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
			local emit = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
			emit.Texture = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
			emit.VelocitySpread = 180
			emit.Speed = NumberRange.new(5, 10)
			emit.Parent = p.Character.Head
		end
	end
end)

-- 7. СКРИМЕРЫ (С оригинальными ID звуков и громкостью 99999)
local function runScreamer(soundId)
	local scr = Instance.new("ScreenGui", PlayerGui)
	scr.Name = "ActiveScreamer"
	
	local img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", scr)
	img.Image = "rbxassetid://14799621400"
	img.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	img.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
	
	local s = Instance.new("Sound", scr)
	s.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. soundId
	s.Volume = 99999
	s:Play()
	
	task.wait(4)
	scr:Destroy()
end

jumpscare1.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	runScreamer("8280196339") -- Вернул оригинальный звук 1
end)

jumpscare2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	runScreamer("613960902")  -- Вернул оригинальный звук 2
end)
